subject: health
unitTitle: Mental Health Support Systems and Crisis Response
title: Mastery check: reducing stigma through accurate language
essentialQuestion: When self-management is not enough, what is the next step and who takes it with me?
privacySafeScenario: Write a peer-support response protocol: what to say, what not to promise, who to bring in, and how to hand off — then draft one short advocacy message for better support access.
studentTask: Learner applies reducing stigma through accurate language to a new fictional scenario and records the response with the reasoning, evidence, or decision process behind it.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, show or explain the most important idea about reducing stigma through accurate language, then name one check that would catch a weak claim or an unsafe step.
completionCriteria: The learner completes the central task about reducing stigma through accurate language without being asked for any private disclosure.
The learner gives evidence, reasoning, a documented process, or a cited source rather than an unsupported claim.
The learner checks or revises the work and can identify a next step.
adaptationChoices: The protocol may be written, spoken, or built from supplied response cards that the learner orders and adapts.
extensionChallenge: Apply reducing stigma through accurate language under a new constraint, compare two approaches, or explain the idea to someone else with an original fictional example, without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.

Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, movement-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, representation, or response mode.

trustedAdultNote: This course teaches health information and does not diagnose; direct urgent safety or health concerns to a trusted adult or qualified professional.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice one safe, optional example of reducing stigma through accurate language in daily life. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or private disclosure is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.

This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
